data.body: Phase D: Fix Approval = USER-APPROVED (interactive). User selected 'Safe core fix' scope + 'Clean automatically after fix'. Complexity = COMPLEX-trigger fires (modifies end-session SKILL.md AND worktree-cleanup.sh/worktree-create.sh) BUT user explicitly authorized this exact scope to be resolved this session -> proceed with implementation (no /dso:brainstorm epic escalation), per always:act-on-explicit-yes. testing_mode=RED (new behaviors: Class A orphan-dir sweep, scratch-debris removal eligibility, end-session invoking removal) + UPDATE (worktree-create count regex). Multi-axis fix -> per-axis RED->GREEN discipline delegated to fix sub-agent.
